title: What Shapes User Trust in ChatGPT? A Mixed-Methods Study of User Attributes, Trust Dimensions, Task Context, and Societal Perceptions among University Students
reasoning: The paper is a user study on trust in ChatGPT. While it includes 'ethical risk' (framed as ethical compliance) as one of its seven primary trust dimensions and discusses user concerns regarding bias and societal impact, it focuses on human perceptions and trust calibration rather than evaluating or benchmarking the model's moral or ethical reasoning capabilities.
